{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The US government has taken a long series of unfortunate actions to destabilize Venezuela.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Trump and other members of his administration have made reckless and worrying comments about the need for foreign military intervention in Venezuela.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The US government has imposed financial sanctions against Venezuela.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Financial sanctions against Venezuela are putting further constraints on the importation of desperately needed food and medicine into Venezuela.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The US government’s sanctions preclude Venezuelan firms from access to US credit.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The US government’s sanctions effectively eliminate the Venezuelan oil sector’s capacity to maintain current levels of production.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Venezuelan oil sector’s capacity to return to pre-2015 levels is eliminated by the US government’s sanctions.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Venezuela depended heavily on oil exports to fund the importation of basic goods.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The US government’s sanctions against Venezuela’s oil sector are tantamount to direct sanctions against the Venezuelan people.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The economic security of the Venezuelan people grows more precarious by the week.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
